# gitea_label (Data Source)

Use this data source to retrieve details of a label in Gitea.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitea_label" "example" {
  user = "my-org"
  repo = "my-repo"
  id   = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Label ID

### Optional

- `org` (String) Organization name
- `repo` (String) Repository name
- `user` (String) User or organization owner of the repository

### Read-Only

- `color` (String) Label color
- `description` (String) Label description
- `exclusive` (Boolean) Whether the label is exclusive
- `name` (String) Label name
